note: Each scenario runs on a fresh DirectorySyncService(generation). ops[].result is the TS return value (or {threw}). snapshot.gen expands to count entities with ids <prefix><index>.

scenarios.name: projects_latest_changes
scenarios.description: Initial snapshot, two upserts of the same project, then changes after seq 1 (seq 3).

scenarios.name: projects_hard_removal_once
scenarios.description: Removal is sequenced once; repeating it returns the same seq; the tombstone shows in removals.

scenarios.name: projects_repeated_observation_same_seq
scenarios.description: Re-observing an identical value never bumps; includeSequence=false returns the bare payload.

scenarios.name: projects_icon_revision_change
scenarios.description: Only the project whose projectIconRevision changed is re-sequenced.

scenarios.name: cursor_resolution_order
scenarios.description: generation mismatch -> generation_changed (or no_cursor when generation absent) -> missing afterSeq -> no_cursor -> readAfter; afterSeq beyond head -> cursor_expired.

scenarios.name: generation_changed_service
scenarios.description: A service with another generation answers an old cursor with a snapshot.

scenarios.name: snapshot_replace_all_mutates
scenarios.description: Snapshot reads call replaceAll first: values absent from the snapshot are removed (tombstoned), changed values bump, order is seq then id.

scenarios.name: workspaces_basic_and_updates
scenarios.description: Workspace snapshot, upsert, removal, includeSequence=false, entries gain syncSeq.

scenarios.name: workspaces_background_generation
scenarios.description: Background-including readers see `<generation>:background` in stamps and reads; update payloads stamped with includeBackground carry the background generation while internal sequence_for uses the bare generation.

scenarios.name: background_reader_alternation
scenarios.description: Quirk: one shared collection is fed by readers with different snapshots. A non-background reader that omits a background-only workspace tombstones it; the background reader then re-adds it with a new seq.

scenarios.name: agents_basic_and_updates
scenarios.description: Agent entries are {agent, project}; ids come from agent.id; sync, upsert, remove.

scenarios.name: ordering_locale_compare
scenarios.description: Same-seq values are ordered by id.localeCompare (ICU, en-US). Mixed case, digits, punctuation, accents.

scenarios.name: tombstone_cap_5000
scenarios.description: 5001 removals trim the oldest tombstone: expiredThroughSeq advances to its seq, so afterSeq below it falls back to cursor_expired.
